"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Superfund cleanups are being accelerated.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The country is cracking down on polluters that have poisoned neighborhoods' air, water, and soil.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Every community will benefit from home energy tax credits, low-cost solar panels, and other programs that can save families money while reducing emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The country is investing in climate-resilient infrastructure that will protect every part of the country from extreme weather and other consequences of climate change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
